commit.subject: LU-20447 ptlrpc: print Nid and target when accurate
commit.message:
LU-20447 ptlrpc: print Nid and target when accurate

To help debug client issues where server failover
has occurred, print both Nid and target in
debug/warn/error traces/messages.

Test-Parameters: envdefinitions=PTLDEBUG="+sec"
Signed-off-by: Bruno Faccini <bfaccini@nvidia.com>
Change-Id: I0260e75d96bbaec441817ace10063cefae07b2ff
